blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. on Monday called on Asean and China to uphold international law, exercise restraint and peacefully settle disputes as he and Chinese Premier Li Qiang opened the 29th Asean-China Summit in Manila. “During this anniversary year, our shared commitment to international law and the peaceful settlement of disputes must be reflected in our actions, including through self-restraint, mutual respect, and practical cooperation,” Marcos said. Marcos and Li co-chaired the summit, which forms part of the Philippines’ hosting of the 49th Asean Summit and Related Summits, bringing together leaders of Asean member states and their […]...
